purpose: Byte-exact reproduction of one Kaggle S6E9 submission from three pinned prediction files.

competition.name: Predicting Electric Vehicle Purchases (Playground Series S6E9)

inputs.description: Public prediction, reproduced verbatim inside the defiaudit dataset.
Public prediction from the defiaudit RealMLP OOF dataset; scored 0.94651 in that dataset's own results table.
inputs.notes: The dataset notebook prose states 0.94652 while its results CSV states 0.94651; this package keeps the per-file table value and does not resolve the conflict.

inputs.description: 19-column L1 logistic stacking meta-model output. Produced by reference/original/round28_run.py.
inputs.own_original_contribution: meta-model design and fitting only; 15 of its 19 input columns are also public predictions

this_output.notes: Rank not recorded. An unassigned project record of 'rank43 / 0.94657' from the same date could not be confirmed as this file, so no rank is claimed.

scores.comparison: Ties the previous confirmed best at the displayed precision. This package does not claim any improvement over 0.94657.

local_metrics.caveat: Historical OOF proxy reused across many rounds of selection; base models were not retrained inside the meta-model folds and the public sources have no paired OOF. This number is not transferable to a leaderboard estimate.
